title: Simon's Lemma B.11 for cones in frame-free form: 2|A|⁴/|x|² + |∇|A|²|²/4 ≤ |A|²·|∇A|²
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P a subspace with dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀ with 0 ∉ M, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M for every r ∈ ℕ, and tx ∈ M for all x ∈ M, t > 0; let ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C^∞ on some open O ⊇ M, with ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x, for every x ∈ M. Throughout: P_y is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M y), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m], |A|²(y) := Σ_j |Dν(y)(P_ye_j)|² (Dν = fderiv ℝ ν), δ_jg(y) := fderivWithin ℝ g M y (P_ye_j). Let C(y) := Dν(y)∘P_y, |∇A|²(x) := Σ_{i,j,k}((D_{P_xe_k}C)(P_xe_i)·P_xe_j)² with D_aC := fderivWithin ℝ C M x a, and |∇|A|²|²(x) := Σ_k (δ_k|A|²(x))². Then for every x ∈ M with |A|²(x) > 0: 2(|A|²(x))²/|x|² + |∇|A|²|²(x)/4 ≤ |A|²(x)·|∇A|²(x). (No minimality is assumed.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, 0 < (∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) → 2 * (∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) ^ 2 / ‖x‖ ^ 2 + (∑ k : Fin P, (fderivWithin ℝ (fun z => ∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν z ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M z)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))) ^ 2) / 4 ≤ (∑ i : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))‖ ^ 2) * (∑ i : Fin P, ∑ j : Fin P, ∑ k : Fin P, (inner ℝ (fderivWithin ℝ (fun y => (fderiv ℝ ν y).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M y)).starProjection) M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))) ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2)
